paragraphs.source_en: The young man gestured with both hands as though the raging flames still blazed before his eyes. “When it seemed there was no escape, Lord Horiuchi had no choice but to cry out, ‘This is Lady Senhime! This is the wife of the Minister of the Right!’ Thus he publicly revealed the young mistress’s identity.” At this point, the young man paused for breath.

paragraphs.source_en: Senhime’s departure was a crucial step toward saving the Ufu’s life.

paragraphs.source_en: After the fall of the Ukita house, Ukita Naomori changed his surname once more to Sakazaki and changed his given name to Narimasa. Thus he was now known to all as Sakazaki Dewa-no-kami Narimasa. With Sakazaki Dewa-no-kami escorting her, there was no need to fear for Senhime. Yet Senhime’s safe departure now clashed violently with Okuhara Shinjūrō’s convictions.

units.source_en: After the fall of the Ukita house, Ukita Naomori changed his surname once more to Sakazaki and changed his given name to Narimasa.

units.source_en: Thus he was now known to all as Sakazaki Dewa-no-kami Narimasa.

units.source_en: Yet Senhime’s safe departure now clashed violently with Okuhara Shinjūrō’s convictions.
units.source_zh: 但，千姬的平安出走，现在却与奥原信十郎的心志产生了激烈冲突。

paragraphs.source_zh: 宇喜多直盛在宇喜多家败亡之后，复改姓坂崎，名字也改成了成正。因此，现在皆称其为坂崎出羽守成正。既然有坂崎出羽守护送，自不必担心千姬。但，千姬的平安出走，现在却与奥原信十郎的心志产生了激烈冲突。

paragraphs.source_en: What would happen if Senhime alone were saved while Hideyori and Lady Yodo took their own lives? The world would surely condemn Lord Ieyasu as cold and heartless, a man who saved only his own granddaughter while watching the Taikō’s orphaned heir go to ruin. And Shinjūrō would become a rustic warrior who had failed to understand Yagyū Mataemon’s true intentions.

units.source_en: What would happen if Senhime alone were saved while Hideyori and Lady Yodo took their own lives?

units.source_en: The world would surely condemn Lord Ieyasu as cold and heartless, a man who saved only his own granddaughter while watching the Taikō’s orphaned heir go to ruin.
units.source_zh: 世人定会评说，家康公乃是个冷酷无情之人，只管救得自己的孙女，眼睁睁看着太阁遗孤走向败亡。

units.source_en: And Shinjūrō would become a rustic warrior who had failed to understand Yagyū Mataemon’s true intentions.
units.source_zh: 这样一来，信十郎也会变成一个未能明白柳生又右卫门心意的乡下武夫。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若只有千姬得救，而秀赖和淀夫人却自杀了断，事情将会怎样？世人定会评说，家康公乃是个冷酷无情之人，只管救得自己的孙女，眼睁睁看着太阁遗孤走向败亡。这样一来，信十郎也会变成一个未能明白柳生又右卫门心意的乡下武夫。

paragraphs.source_en: But in truth, at such a moment, who could spare a thought for the world’s judgment?

units.source_en: But in truth, at such a moment, who could spare a thought for the world’s judgment?

ja.t: にしていられるだろうか。

units.source_zh: 其实，到了这个时候，哪还顾得上世间的议论？

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，到了这个时候，哪还顾得上世间的议论？

paragraphs.source_en: For what purpose had Okuhara Shinjūrō left his homeland and entered Osaka Castle? What face could he show as an upright disciple of the Yagyū school if anyone mistook him for a man who, seeking advancement amid the realm’s turmoil, had brought his band of followers and sold his services to Osaka Castle? Then he would have betrayed the retainers who had always trusted and followed him, and he would be too ashamed ever to face his cousin Mataemon again.

units.source_en: For what purpose had Okuhara Shinjūrō left his homeland and entered Osaka Castle?
units.source_zh: 奥原信十郎到底是为了什么，才背井离乡走进大坂城？

units.source_en: What face could he show as an upright disciple of the Yagyū school if anyone mistook him for a man who, seeking advancement amid the realm’s turmoil, had brought his band of followers and sold his services to Osaka Castle?
units.source_zh: 要是有人误以为他乃是欲趁着天下大乱，为了出人头地，才带着自己的一帮手下卖身与大坂城，身为品行高洁的柳生高徒，他颜面何存？

units.source_en: Then he would have betrayed the retainers who had always trusted and followed him, and he would be too ashamed ever to face his cousin Mataemon again.
units.source_zh: 这样，他既对不起始终信任他、跟随他的属下，也无脸再见表弟又右卫门。

paragraphs.source_zh: 奥原信十郎到底是为了什么，才背井离乡走进大坂城？要是有人误以为他乃是欲趁着天下大乱，为了出人头地，才带着自己的一帮手下卖身与大坂城，身为品行高洁的柳生高徒，他颜面何存？这样，他既对不起始终信任他、跟随他的属下，也无脸再见表弟又右卫门。

paragraphs.source_en: How could he save them? Shinjūrō sat down beneath the willow once more and stared fixedly at the granary where Hideyori and his mother were hiding.

units.source_en: How could he save them?
units.source_zh: 如何才能将他们救出？

paragraphs.source_zh: 如何才能将他们救出？信十郎再次坐到柳树下，目不转睛盯着秀赖母子藏身之仓。
